column1: # Every VRL function Vector 0.58.0 exposes, and what this build does with it.
# Established by mining 45,111 identifier-shaped strings from the vector
# binary and probing every one, so the list is exhaustive rather than a
# sample. tests/unit/test_function_coverage.py asserts reality matches this
# file in BOTH directions - a function that starts or stops compiling fails
# the suite, so the exclusions cannot quietly rot.
#   supported            compiles in the default, sandboxed build
#   feature:full-stdlib  compiles only with the full-stdlib Cargo feature
#   unsupported          cannot work standalone, reason given
